before.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

after.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

observations.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. For subsampled inputs, expand both ceil-sized chroma planes by their sampling factors and crop to the original grid inside every operation, including intermediate acquisition/release. Grayscale includes expanding owned decoded GRAY8 samples into independent RGBA8 inside every operation. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

mechanism: Progressive coefficients remain contiguous in spectral order; existing approximation arrays become natural-order reconstruction workspace after validated EOI. AVX2/BMI2 bounds groups at zero-run insertion/ZRL boundaries, deposits oldest-first correction bits into nonzero lanes and updates signed magnitudes only when the bit is absent. Transactional exact input/work admission or unchanged scalar fallback; no additional allocation, tables or memory admission.
